chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Faddal, from Ali ibn Uqbah, from Musa ibn Ukayl, from al-'Ala' ibn Siyabah, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
You begin in carrying the bier from the right side, then proceed around it from behind to the other side, until you return to the front. Thus is the turning of the mill around it.

key_terms.حَمْلِ: carrying, here referring to carrying the bier
key_terms.دَوَرَانُ ٱلرَّحَى: the rotation of the mill, used as a comparison for the circular movement
key_terms.مِنْ خَلْفِهِ: from behind it, describing the route of movement
key_terms.ٱلسَّرِيرِ: the bier or funeral bier on which the deceased is carried
key_terms.ٱلْجَانِبِ ٱلْآخَرِ: the other side, the opposite side of the bier
key_terms.ٱلْجَانِبِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ: the right side, the point from which carrying begins
key_terms.ٱلْمُقَدَّمِ: the front part, where the circuit returns

ai.seo_question: How should the bier be carried according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner of carrying the bier, beginning from the right side and moving around it in an ordered way. It indicates an etiquette and legal mannerism related to funeral conduct in Shia jurisprudence.
